INFORMATION SHEET

INFORMATION ABOUT THE STUDY
Title of research project: English vocabulary test.

Purpose of the study: The study investigates English vocabulary knowledge.

Principal investigator: Eloi Puig-Mayenco, King's College London & Adel Chaouch-Orozco, the City University of Hong Kong.

YOUR INVOLVEMENT IN THE STUDY

Why have you been selected? Thank you for your consideration to participate in our study. You have been selected to participate in this study because you are a speaker of English.

How will you be involved in this study? The study consists of English vocabulary tests and an English proficiency test.

Time required to complete the study: On average, the study lasts about 40 minutes, but this varies from person to person.

Discomforts, inconveniences expected: There are no known discomforts or inconveniences associated with your participation.

Benefits and/or risks, if any: There are no known risks associated with your participation.

Standard treatment or alternative treatment that may be withheld: • Attention checks: You will encounter attention checks throughout the study. These checks are implemented to ensure that you are paying attention to the task (they are extremely easy and essentially allow us to know that you are focused and not simply selecting random buttons), which is crucial to guarantee the high quality of the data in online settings. • Random responses: We will check your responses in all tasks and questionnaires to ensure they have not been randomly completed.

Important: If responses in the tasks and questionnaires are blatantly random, you will be excluded from the study.

Period in which information collected from the subject will be retained: All personal information will be destroyed after a period of five years from the completion of the project has elapsed.

CONFIDENTIALITY

Who will have access to your data? The principal investigator, Eloi Puig-Mayenco, King's College London, and Adel Chaouch-Orozco, the City University of Hong Kong.

Note that new researchers may get involved in the study at later stages.

How will confidentiality, anonymity and privacy be maintained? Your data will be kept confidential and securely stored, with only your anonymous ID identifying it. All personal information will be destroyed after a period of five years from the completion of the project has elapsed. Taking part in this study is completely voluntary; you may withdraw at any time without having to give any reason. Please feel free to ask any questions that you may have about this study at any point.

YOUR RIGHTS
You have the right to: • Refuse to participate or withdraw at any time for any reason without penalty of any kind. • Request access to and correction of the personal data supplied for the project. • Request further and ongoing information from Dr Eloi Puig-Mayenco (e.puig-mayenco@kcl.ac.uk) & Dr Adel Chaouch-Orozco (adel.chaouchorozco@cityu.edu.hk).

This application has been reviewed by the King's College London Research Ethics Committee and has been given a favourable ethical opinion for conduct. Thank you for your help.
